overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole reviewed a major presentation on the Wellington Transformation Study and voted to enter executive session regarding ongoing litigation.

items.title: Wellington Transformation Study
items.summary: Consultants presented a vision for transforming the Wellington area into a vibrant, walkable, mixed-use commercial center featuring smaller block sizes and 'TuffTech' industrial space. Councilors discussed the market feasibility of the proposals, community engagement efforts, and the net fiscal impact of various housing and commercial development scenarios; the item was kept in committee.

items.title: Executive Session - Turtog v. City of Medford
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy regarding Turtog v. City of Medford because an open meeting could have a detrimental effect on the city's position.
